images.prompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit target: the attached actual portrait photograph of an adult woman lying on her back on a treatment bed under a white red-light LED canopy. Perform minimal photographic restoration and quality enhancement ONLY. Preserve the EXACT original portrait 2:3 composition, camera position, facial identity, face proportions, head angle, neck length, shoulder line, chest, arms, body position, pillow, bed, towel coverage and the exact canopy hardware. The head and both shoulders must remain anatomically correct and visibly supported by the bed, exactly as in the original. Do not reposition, reconstruct, beautify or reshape any part of the woman. Reduce noise, improve fine detail and realistic skin texture, correct exposure and gently reduce the overpowering red cast while retaining realistic red LED illumination. Keep the plain real background; add absolutely no objects, flowers, candles, plants, decorations or luxury interior. No new lights or equipment, no change to goggles, no text or logos, no glossy retouching, no changes of pose, no extension of the scene. The result should look like the same real photograph professionally developed, not an invented advertising image. Portrait 2:3.
